title: Part-Month Administration Fee on New and Suspended Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
content:
The part of the month charged by Stratton Bay's license administration fee on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription follows how the subscription was held. The month is reckoned as a 30-day month.

- **Recently purchased.** A subscription purchased fewer than 30 calendar days before the posting day is charged for the days from its purchase date up to the posting day, with the posting day excluded. Those days are taken over a 30-day month.
- **Suspended.** A subscription held 30 days or more that is suspended when the fee posts is charged only for the part of the 30-day month before its suspension. That part is 30 less the calendar days from its suspension date up to the posting day, taken over 30. A subscription suspended 30 or more days before the posting day has no part of the month left to charge, so no fee is posted.
- **Any other subscription.** No part-month reduction applies.

The purchase moment, the status and the suspension date are read from the subscription record.

## Judgement table

| Calendar days from purchase date to posting day | Status when the fee posts | Calendar days from suspension date to posting day | Part of the month charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | any | — | 12 divided by 30 |
| 29 | any | — | 29 divided by 30 |
| 30 or more | active | — | no part-month reduction |
| 30 or more | suspended | 10 | 20 divided by 30 |
| 30 or more | suspended | 30 or more | none left; no fee is posted |

## Hypothetical illustrations (fee posting on 1 July)

- A subscription purchased on 19 June has 12 days from 19 June up to 1 July, with 1 July excluded. It is charged 12 thirtieths of the month. A full-month fee of 90.00 USD becomes 36.00.
- A subscription held since last year was suspended on 21 June. That is 10 days before the posting day, so it is charged 20 thirtieths. The 90.00 becomes 60.00.
- Suspended on 1 May, 61 days before the posting day, it has no part of the month left to charge, and no fee is posted.
